'''Bellus Tan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Bellus Tan was the son of a shipping magnate from the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. After falling out with his father, he wandered [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], trying to make a good name for himself, in an attempt to and gain his father's forgiveness. He began running goods through the [[Thaereian system]] and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he encountered the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on [[T-4]], the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system.
